one_sentence_story: Brain scans show five thousand steps a day slows bad brain build-up and keeps memory sharp for years.
so_what_for_you: Drop the guilt over ten thousand steps. A brisk twenty-five minute walk each day puts you right in the sweet spot that protects your memory hub.

jargon_map.plain: The point near seven thousand five hundred steps where extra brain gains level off.

jargon_map.plain: Walking briskly like you have somewhere to be.
jargon_map.analogy: Strolling through a shop versus striding to catch a bus.
